maria (docs): Quick sync: planning v1->v2 migration notice. Proposal: 10d soft deprecate, 7d enforcement. Need docs, SDK, and snippets aligned. Will open banner PR tonight.

sam (sdk): Ack. SDK rename: 'model' -> 'model_id'. We'll add a compat shim + migration example. Will open SDK PR with tests.

june (devex): Owners: @sam (sdk), @maria (docs), @leo (oncall). I'll add a troubleshooting FAQ and a smoke curl. Can someone grep for '/v1/invoke' in docs/examples?

sam (sdk): Quick grep: `rg "\/v1\/invoke" docs/ examples/ -n`
Compat snippet for README:
```js
client.call({ model_id: client.alias('gpt-4-redwood') })
```

leo (eng-oncall): I'll prepare canary + rollback command: `./ops/route-switch --to v1-proxy --reason "rollback: migration"`. Monitor >0.5% error delta -> rollback.

lint-bot: Reminder: PRs must pass link-checker and code-block-lint.
